title: Account Executive - Velocity SMB Grower
description:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 The Velocity team is a highly consultative sales team that is responsible for the growth of Stripe’s SMB customers within the region. We work with the most ambitious and fastest growing companies - Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and growth opportunities for their businesses.
 What you’ll do
 As an Account Executive, you’ll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and closing to managing existing relationships and identifying new opportunities to expand Stripe’s footprint within existing accounts. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can execute on sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals.

 Work with existing SMB Stripe customers to develop and execute long-term sales
strategies to expand Stripe’s revenue
Own the full sales cycle, from business case development, deal structuring and negotiating, to
close and activation
 Own a named account list and develop account plans for winning and expanding business with
high growth technology companies
 Develop outbound strategies to create and nurture opportunities
 Drive deal strategy and commercial negotiations for large, complex renewals

title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer, Platform Engineering
location: Remote, Canada; Remote, United Kingdom; Remote, United States
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

 We’re looking for a Principal Engineer with deep expertise in Site Reliability, Backend, or Platform Engineering to help shape the next phase of GitLab Dedicated, our fully managed single-tenant SaaS offering. title: Graphic Designer & Illustrator
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
 The Discord Creative Studio Team is seeking a versatile graphic designer and illustrator with strong conceptual skills and a knack for working across styles. This role sits alongside our Social team, creating fast-turnaround content across a wide range of creative expressions, including illustration, graphic design, and visual storytelling. You'll be embedded with the team, helping bring content to life across platforms in ways that are fun, timely, and resonate with our large and highly engaged community. This is a highly collaborative role. You'll partner closely with members of our Social team and other creatives, working within quick-turnaround windows to keep pace with what's happening in the community in real time.
What You'll Be Doing
 Design and illustrate a wide range of social and community content, from platform graphics and campaign assets to reactive, in-the-moment illustrations, across a variety of styles, including characters, visual effects, objects, and environments.
 Conceptualize and execute quick-turnaround creative that captures cultural moments and community conversations, often within same-day or next-day timelines.
 Partner closely with the Social team to translate ideas, copy, and campaign concepts into visually compelling graphic design and illustration.
 Collaborate with other creatives, including illustrators, motion designers, and brand designers, to maintain a consistent and expressive visual voice across platforms.
 Manage multiple concurrent requests, prioritizing and communicating proactively as timelines shift.

title: Head of Data Engineering
description:
Role: Head of Data Engineering
 Location: Manchester based office – Hybrid working
 Package: £98k OTE
 PHMG is continuing to develop and mature its data capability, focusing on modernising our data platform and enhancing the way we work. This creates further opportunities to leverage data more effectively, allowing us to better serve our customers and colleagues. As part of this continued development, we are looking to strengthen our Data Engineering capability and maximise the value from the wealth of data held across the organisation.
 To support this vision, we are seeking a Head of Data Engineering. This pivotal role will lead an established Data Engineering team, supporting their development while strengthening engineering practices, technical standards and ways of working across the function. The successful candidate will foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.
 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced data engineering leader to help develop our data engineering community of practice, define data standards across the organisation and be part of the team delivering and evolving PHMG's Data Strategy.
 The role: What you will do:
 Lead, manage and develop the Data Engineering team, building capability, resilience and strong ways of working.
 Own PHMG's core data platform, architecture, data warehouse and associated pipelines, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable and cost-effective.
 Own Data Engineering delivery, ensuring work is appropriately designed, prioritised and delivered to agreed standards.
 Establish and embed strong engineering practices across source control, CI/CD, testing, code review, documentation, monitoring and error handling.
 Work closely with the wider Data team to translate the Data Strategy and business priorities into an effective engineering roadmap and delivery plan.

title: Product Owner - Communications Channels & AI
description:
Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI
 Location: Manchester
 Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm
 Package: £80k OTE
 As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth.
 You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position.
 Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda.
 Key Objectives
 Core Accountability
 Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
 Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
 Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
 Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
 Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.
 Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap
 Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
